heroes.body: Antalya's final text never mentions fossil fuels. The EU, Britain and island states rejected it; president Murat Kurum said it was not adopted. The longest climate summit on record closes empty-handed.
heroes.headline: COP31 ends with no deal

heroes.body: A Russian drone hit a five-storey block on Sunday night; 11 are dead, among them a teenager. A boy of seven was pulled alive. Fifteen died across the Kyiv region.
heroes.headline: Death toll in Dymer rises to 11

heroes.body: Seven Ukrainian sea drones sank the corvette Merkury at Benghazi naval base on Sunday, Kyiv said, and hit the cargo ship MV Angara. A Ka-27 helicopter aboard was destroyed.
heroes.headline: Ukraine sinks a Russian warship off Libya
